verdict.rationale: Any public-facing agency website could publish llms.txt or agent-oriented docs, so this axis applies. Direct probes found no such resources: llms.txt, a markdown version of the docs page, and every OpenAPI path tried returned HTTP 404. The rest of the pack is ordinary human-oriented guidance pages and videos, with the transactional portal behind a login wall.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
